title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
You can use the transaction ETOUEXCEPTRESPOl1 (accessed from the SAP Easy Access Menu as follows: |}Utilities Industry
Billing» Time-of-Use Exceptions » Monitor and Edit Time-of-Use Exceptions “) to monitor and edit time-of-use exceptions. You
can also use it to create, change, and delete TOU exceptions or change their response category. You can also navigate to the

relevant TOU exception program.

Prerequisites

To be able to create TOU exception responses, an appropriate TOU exception is required. You use transaction ETOUEXCEPT@2 to
create TOU exceptions. See Monitor and Process Time-of-Use Exceptions.

Features

You can select the TOU exception responses you want to monitor or edit using a combination of different criteria, such as a user

name, a contract, a device, an exception program ID, or an exception source. You can also restrict the number of selected TOU
exception responses by making an appropriate entry in the Time-Dependent Selection and Technical Options screen areas (field
Restrict Number To), or you can select only responses with the response category Opt-In or Opt-Out.

For more information about the possible selection criteria and the combinations available, see the documentation for the report
RETOUEXCEPTRESP DISP MAINT.

Monitor TOU Exception Responses

You can use the Change Layout function to add additional fields (Such as administration data and texts). By selecting a line and
choosing |)Goto » Display Change Document 3 in the menu, you can navigate to the available change documents for the selected
TOU exception response.

Create TOU Exception Responses

You use transaction ETOUEXCEPTRESP@2 to create TOU exception responses (SAP Easy Access Menu: |/Utilities Industry
Billing » Time-of-Use Exceptions » Create Time-of-Use Exception Responses %). Choose a contract and a TOU exception for
which a response is to be created and enter the response category: The system automatically determines all relevant registers for
the contract and creates a separate TOU exception response for each one. You can override this behavior in the BAd|

ISU_ISU TOUEXCEPTRESP LEVEL if, for example, you only want to create TOU exception responses for specific registers.

If the TOU exception program of the selected TOU exception does not refer to any of the rates in the billing schema extension that
are used for the contract, the TOU exception response cannot be created for this contract. A TOU exception would not be able to be
created for this TOU exception program.

You can use the Create Individual TOU Exception function to create an individual TOU exception instead of selecting a predefined
TOU exception. If you execute this function, the system calls the transaction for creating TOU exceptions. In this transaction, you
can create a TOU exception for a TOU exception program with the activation category Active for Individual Customers.

Change Response Category

By selecting one or more lines and executing the function TOU Exception Opt-In or TOU Exception Opt-Out, you can change the
response category of the TOU exception response to Opt-In or Opt-Out. The system automatically changes the response category
for all registers of the selected contract. You can override this behavior in the BAd| ISU_TOUEXCEPTRESP_LEVEL if, for example,

you want a different response category for each register.

Delete TOU Exception Responses
